title: Esho Maa Lakshmi
desc: Devotees celebrate Goddess Lakshmi with prayers, rituals and heartfelt devotion, seeking prosperity, blessings and harmony in their homes and lives.

title: Tomai Pabo Bole
desc: Two neighbouring families are embroiled in a bitter rivalry. However, in an interesting turn of events, the son of one family falls in love with the daughter of the other.

title: Sangharsha
desc: In a village divided by corruption and power struggles between a politician and a doctor, honest newcomer Shubhankar challenges the status quo.

title: Bhalobasa Bhalobasa
desc: Sidhu meets and falls in love with a woman named Priya despite being engaged to a different girl. He soon has to make a choice between following his heart and respecting his father's wishes.

title: Geet Sangeet
desc: Abandoning his affluent background, a man chases his musical dreams. However, he finds himself employed as a driver and becomes smitten with his boss's daughter.

title: Jwar Bhata
desc: Bijay, a rich tea estate owner's son, angers his father when he marries a poor girl. Ranjan, his cousin, tries to make the most of the situation by usurping his property.
